responsibility: Implements GCC’s source-location and source-text access support underneath diagnostics and line maps. This file owns global line_table/input_location state, the file_cache machinery for reading and caching source lines with charset/BOM handling, and helpers for turning encoded locations into file/line/column information and source text spans; it also supports display-width and byte/display-column conversions needed for UTF-8-, tab-, and line-oriented diagnostic rendering.
same_name_distinction: Implementation file for the input pair: it owns the global line_table/input_location state and the concrete file_cache, source-line reading, charset/BOM handling, and byte/display-column conversion logic, whereas input.h provides the location macros, data structure declarations, and public APIs.
